title: A Breath Past the Check

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The hand on the knife-sill stays a breath beyond the counting and no house can check it; the strip stays in the sleeve, the crack stays showing, and the figure goes up where figures go.
epigraph.attribution: A yard saying of Low Kiln, in the dark month

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and forty-two to three hundred and forty-four days, six months and one hundred and sixty-two to one hundred and sixty-four days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. No present-tense break and no tagged memory: the old life is carried by the surgeon's register alone. Each morning that register takes the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped, because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform — and reads the world as a trauma bay is read, by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie. He knows the composed face is not composure, knows a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly, never rubbed, never set too near the fire; he knows the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle is louder than the surgeon's knowing, and neither wins, and the argument is the work. Three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands: the carried fire's four low pulls with its fifth unpaid through three hundred and forty-two, forty-three and forty-four days and its payer unnamed; the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot; the river's water over water, a low thing over a lower thing, never numbered among the hearings. Six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a woman as the men lifted her, filed where a thing out of a person must go. Seven arithmetics of the year stand behind one unsigned figure — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, and Ash's first, gone up the road on the tenth in Berr Clay's locked box — seven are seven and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer. Six openings in six months are six and not a rule, the sixth at the kiln mouth on Ash 2, the widow's mark untouched at every other hour. Forward, not closed.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Thirteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{342}{Ash 13, Thirdday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Thirdday, with no market, Cross or bell and no collector on the clay road. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on answer 258 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it without looking, and carry 341 to 342 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-two days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 342 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). No recap of Chapter 96: nothing from the tenth, eleventh or twelfth crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and the reading went up where readings go up and answered nothing under this roof. Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches from the ear, stiff and leathery in the dry kiln heat, corner standing a hair off the wool, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop beyond a warming nobody here will perform. Composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; the infant wants the crust lifted two inches, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle. Both true, the second louder, neither wins; the argument is the work (T060/T086). Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells the coals it is the thaw, turns them with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, counts a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeps her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal tally stays unread, moves her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glances once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crosses the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline left showing, turns the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, and sets the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark hangs where it hangs and is not touched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due. The Ash 9 held breath at the wire stays where it was set beside the five objects and is expressly not a sixth, not made again on this morning (T009/T013/T092, T060/T086 held). Seven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure and Ash's second stands offstage on a day not earned. The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the note's own finishing and comes straight down against the fold — answer **two hundred and fifty-nine**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the seven arithmetics, the bell's gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, Ilva's wood, the pot-crack resting nor his own gaps (T061/T082). Ends on the small sound of the river under the door and the file open on the towel with every gap left gap.

scenes.title: What the Yard Goes Around
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 13 through the going of the light and the bed, at the Clay Yard, the seven walked-around places, the rack end, the yard well and flat stone, the kindling, flagstones, wheel-shed edge and damper, the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; walk-ons (the Cold Acre hare-carrier answering the price with the weather, the man with a cracked jar in a rope sling sent to a pot that says nothing, a woman with a basket of kindling, two men mending a strip of fence saying the thaw will be early and late); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa, no runner, no collector, no market, Cross or bell. Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey beside it called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan's round ring, the trough's skin, the field's empty place on the worked strips, the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone out of the path of feet, and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried). The three coverings stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and no fourth likeness is made a cause (T083/T085 held). The dressed grain lies turned under wool at the rack end with no figure and no handful (T077). Hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures; Tarn says *Yes, house* to the early thaw and the late and keeps the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument can find a foot (T077, T036/T076). At the going of the light the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first at the wire and the hairline of the original break is left showing between brass and wire; the Ash 9 held breath at the crossing stays where it was set, beside the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the handful, the thumb's resting and the sixth opening, expressly not a sixth held object, not made again, not joined to the charcoal, Ilva's strip, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the Ash 6 turning, the covered grain or his gaps, with no payer (T009/T013/T092, T100, T060/T086 held). At the kindling Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill; his thumb's resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 is checked and not made again, not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment and not a rule (T036/T076/T006 held). Jorra comes through the finger's-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, parts dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, names neither the men who went low into the back room before first grey nor the room, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*; *You'll do*), knows the full note that pot will give three turns ahead and withholds it from any High Kiln master who would make a song of it, and puts his bent finger into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence so the end of it arrives at the pot, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise to the slate-burners is neither given nor withdrawn; the burned slate stays at five and the Ash 5 joining held apart with no sixth and no witness (T035/T031/T065/T095 held). Sella sets him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, rights the fold without a look at his face, leaves the thread where it lay, and says *The house will keep it*. In the small hours the hand takes its small intake, holds the interval whole and lets it go on the river's note — answer **two hundred and sixty** — and the file on the towel stays open with every gap left gap (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Fourteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{343}{Ash 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner, no collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 13 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment. Carry 342 to 343 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-three days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 343 days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order; composed face not composure; a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly; surgeon versus infant quarrel, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds: fire before basket; coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot; *The house will keep it*; intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured; finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread; lips along a two-gapped row unfigured; one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air; twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing; dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful; pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). The widow's mark is untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh is made due (T058/T079). Seven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure, seven readings seven and not one account, the finding on a place of its own with no payer; Ash's second stands offstage on Day 349 and is not brought into a day that has not earned it (T015/T041/T047 held). The six hearings keep the seventh place empty; the heard bell stays beside the told; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings, nine hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end are all checked and left as they lie (T061/T082, T078, T101, T090, T035/T031/T065/T095, T036/T076 held). The hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note and makes answer **two hundred and sixty-one**, let go on the note's own finishing, neither early again nor stayed, worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082). Ends with the boy unable to spend any of it and not treating that as a grievance, for a grievance is an account with a payer standing under it and none stood.

scenes.title: A Breath Past the Check
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, chapter close of the second day and the chapter's one meaningful change, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 14 at the Clay Yard, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and the damper, then the going of the light, the pot board and the bed. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Tarn, Jorra Vail; walk-ons (Cold Acre hare, cracked-jar man, woman with kindling, two fence-menders); Garl in objects. No Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa, no collector, no market, Cross or bell. The yard goes around its seven places and the three coverings stay weather; hunts and repairs are answered with the weather, the pot and the carrying arm (T009/T013/T092, T077, T083/T085, T098 carried). **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T036/T076/T006, held with T061/T082):** at the kindling Tarn sets the small knife at the very edge of its sill where it can be checked and where a man's hand could also slip it off, passes his hand over it as the house checks, and the hand stays at the sill a breath longer than the check requires before he takes it away. He does not cut, count, bring the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan, spend the Seed 16 breath or make the thumb's resting of Bone 26 again; he tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* and says *Yes, house* to the early thaw and the late, keeping the late because it puts off the paying. The boy files the held breath at the sill on a place of its own beside the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the handful let fall at the rack end, Tarn's thumb's resting on the uncut seventh, the sixth opening at the kiln mouth and the Ash 9 pot-crack resting, with a finger between every pair: expressly not a sixth held object, not a seventh of anything, not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a habit, a way, a hearing, a near-full answer, a sign, a mending, a cause, a payment or a rule, not made again, not joined to the charcoal, Ilva's strip, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the Ash 6 turning, the covered grain or his own gaps, with no payer standing under it. It gathers toward the far-off hand that will lay the district's private keepings together, and that hand is not his and is still far off. Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parts dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it, names neither the men in the back room before first grey nor the room, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence; one piece of iron has two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies (T062/T035/T031). *He's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise ungiven; the burned slate stands at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings, and no sixth telling, third telling or witness came due (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held). At the going of the light the twice-mended pot is lifted thumb-first at the wire with the hairline left showing and both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person; Sella sets him on the bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, rights the fold without a look at his face and leaves the thread where it lay. In the small hours the hand takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole, lets it go on the river's note and comes straight down — answer **two hundred and sixty-two** — and the seven arithmetics stay behind one unsigned figure with Ash's first locked up the road and Ash's second five mornings ahead, named only as a date (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Fifteenth Morning
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{344}{Ash 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Garl in objects. No Tarn, no Jorra, no Ilva, no runner, no collector this morning. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Ash 14 crosses as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the breath held at the knife-sill stayed where it was put and buys no lesson under this roof. Carry 343 to 344 exact, six months and one hundred and sixty-four days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid 344 days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken the same number (T009/T013/T092). Body inventory renewed in the surgeon's old order: crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; composed face not composure, a cold patient cannot clot; the infant's want of the crust lifted, thread wiped and hand on the pot handle louder than the surgeon's knowing, both true, neither winning (T060/T086). Hearth grammar holds at both ends of the day: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar under lead glaze with the little-door burn closing on air, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077). Widow's mark untouched — a morning and a hearth are not openings; six openings in six months and not a rule, no seventh made due (T058/T079). Seven arithmetics stand behind one unsigned figure with no signature on the space; Ash's second belongs to its own morning five ahead and is not brought early (T015/T041/T047 held). The file lies open on the towel with every gap left gap; the six hearings keep the seventh place empty and the heard bell stays in its square beside the told; the hand-at-the-sill object, the pot-crack resting, the handful, the thumb's resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go and the sixth opening sit each on its own place with a finger between and none stands up and calls itself a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T061/T082, T036/T076, T060/T086 held). The hand comes up an inch toward the river's note for answer **two hundred and sixty-three**, let go whole on the note's own finishing (T061/T082). Ends on 344 exact, six months and 164 days, told by nobody, and the count going on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax.

scenes.title: Seven Behind One Figure, Held
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: the afternoon of Ash 15 at the yard well and the flat stone, the Clay Yard's seven places, the rack end, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge and damper, then the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail, Ilva (once at the well, strip unread, ninth hand nine), Tarn, Jorra Vail; walk-ons (a woman waiting her turn at the well asking what Ash's firings have taken, the Cold Acre hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, a woman with a basket of kindling, two fence-menders); Garl in objects. No Berr, no Hessa, no runner seen on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no collector up or down the clay road, no market, Cross or bell. Ilva draws at the yard well with the pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and the finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; her hands know the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and have never been soft, and people notice the pail first and the sleeve not at all. To a woman who asks what Ash's firings have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays; the short strip of notched birch bark, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, is not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any ownerless saying, and no figure comes off the wood. Eyes to the asker, mouth opening after both with a half-beat: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* — the question put and not the one behind it. Flat hand once more on the sleeve and back to the pail, nobody turning twice. The boy takes the order of reaching apart as a surgical field is taken apart and files it as the **ninth** record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale's eighth; he files **no tenth**, makes no figure of the slate's nearness, makes her no reader of her own keeping and joins her to none. There is no ownerless saying at this well, she is expressly not the speaker of any voice, no fifth shaping comes and the turned writing stays a sighting (T080 advanced, not paid; T090 held). Back under the roof the whole tray is checked and left as it lay: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the sixth the small flat knock out of a person filed where a thing out of a person must go; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, not fetched in to make a seventh or a fourth count (T078); the told figure beside the paid with no signature on the space, and **seven arithmetics of the year — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, and Ash's first — behind one printed figure, seven seven and not one account**, Ash's first locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay's box and Ash's second standing five mornings ahead on a day that has not earned it (T015/T041/T047 held). The edges come near to touching and the finger goes between; the finding stays on a place of its own with no payer and is not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the handful, the thumb's resting, the two small objects of the hand, the sixth opening, the three Ash 5/6 movements, the pot-crack resting, the new hand-at-the-sill breath or his gaps (T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T061/T082 held). Nine record-first hands stand with no tenth; nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; the row stands at five askings with no sixth and no witness; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying and the Ash 6 turning of Hessa's writing each on a place of its own with a finger between, none spent, paid, named or promoted (T090, T036/T076, T101, T035/T031/T065/T095 held). Garl stays in objects and not in a story: the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, the hollow wheel-seat nobody fills, the clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw unswept both, the twice-mended pot with the hairline showing between brass and wire and both proverbs gone to pot and fire, the unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch; his name has not been spoken under this roof three hundred and forty-four days, his tile debt stays uncalled and the keeping of him is maintenance and not a story (T009/T013/T092). At the going of the light Sella carries him up at the half-pace, goes wide around the seven places, sets him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, rights the fold without a look at his face, lets her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it goes away and leaves the thread where it lay; she goes to the hearth before the basket and says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say I, and does not touch the widow's mark, because a going of the light and a bed are not openings (T058/T079). Under the floor the carried fire keeps four and its gap, overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot, and through the finger's-width door water over water goes low over lower and is never numbered among the hearings — three counts in three places and none rises into another, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood (T088, T061/T082). In the small hours the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holds the interval whole and lets it go on the note's own finishing, then comes straight down and lays itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking — answer **two hundred and sixty-four**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer (T061/T082). **Two hundred and sixty-four honest answers** stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and **three hundred and forty-four** stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and one hundred and sixty-four days told by nobody, the carried fire's fifth unpaid the same number and Garl's name unspoken the same. Ash keeps its fifteenth day without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months is corrected. Ash 20 (Day 349), the second Account-day and market, stands five mornings ahead and is named only as a date, never as a promise and never brought into a day that has not earned it. The file lies open on the towel at the head of the bed with every gap left gap; the twice-mended pot stands on the pot board with the hairline showing; the hand-at-the-sill breath stays where it was put and is not made again; nothing on the fifteenth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended. Forward, not closed.
